text: Unleashed or Katana? Same shortlist. Different strengths.
Unleashed is inventory software first. Stock, wholesale and sales channels.
Katana puts production at the centre. Routings, and a Shop Floor App for operators.
In Unleashed, production is a module. It's not on the Lite package.
Unleashed has three packages. Lite, Core or Pro. Plus paid extras.
Katana is free up to 30 SKUs. Then one annual price, not per user.
Both connect to Xero and QuickBooks Online. Neither has a native MYOB connection.
Stock is the hard part? Unleashed. Production? Katana.
Read the full comparison at zudoworks.com
